Reconstruct one PMAGRESULT-style ROCKMAG code per RESULTNO/ROCKNAME from original-paper text, then derive R3 directly as 1 when a field is reconstructed.
Prediction code reads only identity_manifest.json and data/parsed_mds/<REFNO>.txt. PMAGRESULT, historical R3, prior predictions and evaluation files are forbidden.
A performed method claim must contain the complete normalized ROCKNAME; carrier/diagnostic evidence may be added only on that same target page.
Accepts the existing retriever's same-sentence/paragraph/table/discourse/section target binding, plus strong target-page context; method and carrier/diagnostic must be on the same or adjacent page.
R3=1 iff prediction_status=PRESENT; ABSENT and all ABSTAIN states map to compatibility value 0.
Opened only after strict and practical JSONL predictions and SHA-256 receipts were frozen.
Rows sharing the same REFNO and normalized ROCKNAME cannot be separated without component/site/pole locators and are marked ABSTAIN_IDENTITY.
Historical ROCKMAG and historical R3 are related but not equivalent. Oracle ROCKMAG-presence accuracy against R3 is reported explicitly.
The 10 papers were deliberately selected for multi-target difficulty and historical variation; metrics are diagnostic, not independent generalization estimates.
